title: Unit 23 Consolidation: Urban Space, Architecture & Coexistence

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can use amely or aki with a postposition (amely mellett, amely által, akik között)
I can use amelynek or akiknek with a possessed noun (amelynek udvarán, amelynek révén)
